success_criteria: run one short stage-2 PPO continuation, not a long unguarded PPO run
keep actor inputs unchanged and hidden labels out of the actor
run fixed M162 outcome objective after the stage
run full M164 boundary replay after the stage
run M169 fragile row guard with required row 67 after the stage
run behavior retention and protected-key gates only if full replay and row67 guard pass

accept a candidate that preserves aggregate count by swapping rows
